name: Post Query Loop for Blog, News & Magazine Sites – Ansar Elements
author: themeansar

sections.description:
Ansar Elements is a free, lightweight Elementor addon built for news, blog, and magazine websites.

Build dynamic post displays with the Post Query Loop widget — choose from Standard, Overlay, or List card layouts, filter posts by category or tag, control columns and gaps responsively, and add pagination. No coding needed.

Every widget is built with SEO-friendly HTML structure, support for Schema Markup, and fast loading performance which helps your website appear more relevant and fast to search engines.

📰 Post Query Loop Widget

The core widget. Full control over how your posts are displayed:

Layout

  • 3 card presets: Standard (image top), Overlay (content over image), and List (horizontal)
  • Responsive columns — set 1–5 columns separately for desktop, tablet, and mobile
  • Control column gap and row gap independently
  • Works with any post type

Query

  • Filter posts by category, tag, author, or custom taxonomy
  • Set posts per page (1–100)
  • Order by date, popularity, or custom fields

Card Content

  • Show or hide: featured image, title, excerpt, category, meta, and read more button
  • Control excerpt length
  • Custom button text and icon

Pagination

  • Numbered pagination with previous / next controls
  • Custom prev/next labels

Full Style Controls

  • Style every card element — image, title, category, meta, excerpt, and button
  • All styling controls are responsive

🛠️ Theme Builder Modules

Build the full site around your content:

  • Header Builder – Custom headers for your blog or news site
  • Footer Builder – Dynamic footers with full widget support
  • Archive Builder – Custom layouts for category and tag pages
  • Single Post Builder – Unique templates for posts and articles
  • 404 Page Builder – Branded error pages

🧩 Theme Builder Widgets

  • Site Logo – Custom sizing and linking
  • Site Title & Tagline – Styled to match your brand
  • Navigation Menu – Horizontal, vertical, or mobile-expandable
  • Search Widget – Multiple layout styles
  • Copyright – Auto-updating year, zero maintenance

✅ Why Ansar Elements

  • 100% free — core widgets with no feature limits
  • Lightweight — scripts and styles load only where used, keeping your site fast
  • Works with the free version of Elementor — no Pro required
  • Built specifically for news, blog, and magazine sites
  • Beginner-friendly with advanced controls for power users
  • Follows WordPress coding standards
  • Compatible with most modern WordPress themes

⚡ Pro Version

Unlock advanced publishing features:

  • Category Filter Bar – Let visitors filter posts by category without a page reload
  • Section Heading – Styled headings with accent lines above your post grids
  • Post Counter – Display post numbers on each card
  • Editorial Layout Widget – Magazine-style layouts with featured + supporting post combinations
  • Featured Posts Widget – Hero layouts: cover, left/right side, top/bottom with small posts

💡 Built For

News websites · Online magazines · Bloggers · Content publishers · Editorial sites · Personal blogs
sections.installation:
1. Go to Plugins → Add New in your WordPress dashboard
  2. Search for Ansar Elements
  3. Click Install Now, then Activate
  4. Make sure Elementor is installed (free version works fine)
  5. Open any page in Elementor — find the Post Query Loop widget in the panel
  6. Drag it onto your page and start building
sections.faq:
Is this plugin completely free?

Yes. The Post Query Loop widget and all theme builder modules are free.

Do I need Elementor Pro?

No. Ansar Elements works fully with the free version of Elementor.

Will it slow down my site?

No. Scripts and styles are loaded conditionally — only on pages where the widgets are used.

What card layouts are available in the free version?

Three layouts: Standard (image top, content below), Overlay (content over image), and List (horizontal card).

Can I control how many columns show on mobile?

Yes. Column count is fully responsive — set separate values for desktop, tablet, and mobile independently.

How is this different from JetEngine or other post grid plugins?

Ansar Elements is free, lightweight, and focused on blog, news, and magazine use cases. No bloated feature sets, no subscription required for the core widget.

What does the Pro version include?

Pro adds the Category Filter Bar, Section Heading, Post Counter, Editorial Layout widget, and Featured Post widget with hero-style layouts.

Does it work with my theme?

Yes. Compatible with most modern WordPress themes that support Elementor.

Is support available?

Yes. Free support is available through the WordPress.org support forums.

Is it translation-ready?

Yes. The plugin follows WordPress standards and is ready for translation.
